_doc: plan-8675 C3: the phone windows whose content is PUBLIC. A visible window matching no rule makes the surface personal (fail-safe). title is a full-match regex over the window title from `dumpsys window windows`. Measured on android-35 (S0 AVD): NotificationShade is visible only while the shade is open, so it is deliberately absent here.

public_windows.title: StatusBar
public_windows.why: clock, battery and notification ICONS; the shade's text lives in NotificationShade

public_windows.title: (Splash Screen )?com\.android\.settings(/.*)?
public_windows.why: S1's public proof app (its activities and its splash screen)

public_windows.title: (Splash Screen )?com\.google\.android\.calculator(/.*)?
public_windows.why: a harmless public app (its activities and its splash screen)

public_windows.title: Application Not Responding: com\.android\.systemui
public_windows.why: the 'System UI isn't responding' dialog: no content but that sentence and Wait/Close (measured: endemic under software rendering on a loaded 2-core host; -gpu host is refused there). Any OTHER app's not-responding dialog names that app and stays unlisted.

public_windows.title: com\.android\.systemui\.wallpapers\.ImageWallpaper
public_windows.why: the wallpaper: pixels only, and pixels are never kept; it shows behind splash screens (measured)
